curated.notes: Go-wide tokens with anthems and Overrun. Forge's GO_WIDE plan wants two finishers it can hold until lethal (OVERRUN role) and 16 cheap bodies or token makers, which the deck has. PLAY_AGGRO lets the wide board attack instead of keeping every token home as a blocker (§17: notNeededAsBlockers is relaxed only by PLAY_AGGRO); token abilities are used every time. Key cards order the tutors (Harvest Season and Farhaven fetch lands, so mostly discard protection here) and the Monte Carlo plan.
curated.by: hand, from the decklist and Forge's plan detectors (DESIGN.md §19)

playbook.notes: Go wide: attack with every creature not needed to survive the strongest opponent's counter-attack, whenever three or more can go. Forge's own attack logic keeps most of the board home (§17); anthems and lifelink tokens reward swinging. Version 1 aimed at the lowest life (+6.5 points over 200 tables, a lean, §20). Version 2 aims at the highest life and splits the attack once a defender is dead, which is what turned Goblin Storm's 40 tables from 5 wins to 9 (§21): the lowest-life target kills the players who were also attacking the leader.
